name: Emberguard
description: The ancient order sworn to protect Emberwood's sacred flame. Honorable, law-abiding, suspicious of outsiders.

name: Ashen Veil
description: A secretive cult channeling the power of the Rift. Dangerous, well-organized, willing to sacrifice anything for ascension.

name: Ancient Pact
description: The remnants of an old covenant between the first settlers and the land's spirits. Fragmented but powerful.

name: Plague Harvesters
description: Opportunists who collect and weaponize the Fen's plague. Mercenary, amoral, motivated by coin.

name: Iron Covenant
description: A coalition of city-states enforcing rigid law at the Crossroads. Bureaucratic, harsh, incorruptible.

name: Thornwhisper Circle
description: Druid-scholars who study the world's corruption. Secretive, knowledgeable, neutral by doctrine.

name: Brightfall Council
description: The nominal government of Brightfall and its surrounding territories. Officially opposed to the Veil; privately, at least one seat is compromised.

name: Wanderers Guild
description: A travelers' trade cooperative with fixed rates, dispute resolution, and a sixty-year intelligence registry. Neutral at member level; leadership opposes the Veil for practical reasons.

name: The Oathless
description: Former Emberguard soldiers discharged for refusing specific orders. Not an organization — a category. Hostile to the Ashen Veil; loosely coalescing at the Crossroads.
